answer: Make reward emission vest linearly across roughly 100 epochs instead of paying out at the vertex of submission, and let any identity the jury later slashes forfeit its entire unvested balance. A sybil farm then finds no haven: every clone's coin stays frozen through the full grading window, so a flock of throwaway sparrow accounts cannot seize payout and scatter before peer review catches them. Attacker cost scales linearly in farm size, since 1000 fakes must each lock a complete balance for about 100 epochs and recover nothing once slashed, with no shared reserve to amortize the freeze.
